note: METHOD: one background script (three threads) through scripts/chamber/fetch_throttled.py: Deezer (album and track searches on the name, plus the surname alone), MusicBrainz (artist match on name and dates, then works with recording-rels; 94 of 94 composers returned) and Apple composerTerm song searches (all composers whose Deezer search showed no strong chamber album; the others by hand), then Deezer/Apple album track lists, IMSLP api.php page facts and 5 web searches to confirm. KEPT: Mysliveček 21 (6 cello sonatas and quartets Nos. 1-6, quintet-sinfonias 1-3 on IMSLP and 4-6 added, 3 oboe quintets added), Pichl 6, Monza 6 (added), Michl 6 (added), Pugnani 3, Paër 3, Naumann 3, Massonneau 3 (added), Marin 2, Peter 2, and one each of Pössinger, Meyerbeer, F.X. Mozart, Moller (added, low), Nisle (added) and Patouart. SECOND LOOK: (1) Mysliveček's quartets: keys follow the Vox Aurae disc, the IMSLP print (Welcker) has no keys on its page; Supraphon's Doležal Quartet call the F and A major 'Op. 3' and a G major 'posth.'. The Op. 2 quintets (Venier, B-flat, E, G, A, D, C) are a different set from the recorded quintet-sinfonias (G, E-flat, C, A, F, B-flat). (2) Pichl: Kocian Quartet (Multisonic 1995) B-flat clarinet quartet and C-major string quartet, and a G-major string-trio Divertimento W. VIb:13 (Deutsches Streichtrio, TYXArt 2022), are credited to Pichl but could not be matched to IMSLP pages; The WIG Society Chamber Music Ensemble's 2024 'Galant Night Fever' has Pichl quartets Op. 4 No. 6 and Op. 10 No. 6. (3) Nisle: the CPO disc's Octet in D (flute, clarinet, 2 horns ad lib., 2 violins, viola, cello, double bass) and Septet in E-flat (8 parts listed) were left out because the part counts are unclear. (4) Pössinger: the Capriccio disc also has a Trio Concertante in D, Op. 36 No. 2 and a Serenade in G minor, Op. 69 No. 2, scoring unconfirmed.
